matches.preview: Derby are slight favourites at 47% in the model's assessment, with Swansea given a 26% chance of an away victory. The hosts showed inconsistent form when last seen, alternating wins and losses across their final six matches of the previous campaign, though a 2-0 home victory over Swansea in February stands out. Swansea finished stronger with three wins from six games. Derby hold the head-to-head advantage, having won both meetings last season. With under 2.5 goals at 54%, the model expects a relatively low-scoring contest.
matches.preview_zh: 根據模型評估，Derby 為輕微看好的一方，評估概率為 47%；Swansea 客場勝利的概率為 26%。Derby 主隊在上個賽季末表現不穩定，最後六場比賽交替贏輸，但 2 月主場以 2:0 戰勝 Swansea 的表現令人矚目。Swansea 後期表現較佳，最後六場中取得三場勝利。Derby 在對陣紀錄上佔優勢，上賽季兩次交手均戰勝對手。模型預期本場比賽進球較少，2.5 球以下的概率為 54%。

matches.preview: Middlesbrough are favoured at 52% to win this Championship encounter, with West Bromwich Albion's chances rated at 22%. The head-to-head record tells the story: Middlesbrough have won all five recent meetings, including 3-2 in January. Boro's home form last season produced strong results, notably a 5-1 victory over Watford, though draws regularly appear in their record. West Brom showed efficiency in their home games yet demonstrated consistent away vulnerabilities. The goals forecast is perfectly balanced at 50-50 for over 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: Middlesbrough 在本場英冠對賽中獲勝機率為 52%，West Bromwich Albion 的勝算為 22%。交手記錄清楚地說明：Middlesbrough 近五次對戰全部獲勝，其中包括一月份的 3-2 勝利。Boro 上賽季主場表現強勢，特別是對陣 Watford 的 5-1 大勝，不過戰績中也經常出現平手。West Brom 主場表現高效，但客場一直存在薄弱環節。進球預測完全均衡，超過 2.5 球的機率為 50-50。

matches.preview: Wolverhampton are favoured at 59%, though the model hedges considerably with 24% for a draw and 17% for a Stoke victory. No previous meetings exist between the teams. Wolverhampton showed mixed form in the Premier League last season, collecting three draws and three defeats from their final six games, while Stoke faced a considerably harder Championship campaign characterised by five defeats and only one draw from their six matches. The total-goals market leans slightly toward over 2.5 at 54%.
matches.preview_zh: Wolverhampton被看好，模型預測勝率為59%，但也預留了相當的不確定性，平手機率為24%，Stoke勝率為17%。兩隊之前沒有交手記錄。Wolverhampton在上賽季英超聯賽中表現參差不齊，最後六場比賽中獲得三場平手和三場敗績，而Stoke面臨難度較大的英冠賽季，最後六場比賽中有五場敗績，僅有一場平手。總進球數市場略微傾向2.5球以上，佔54%。

matches.preview: Blackburn are modestly favoured at 45%, though the model suggests an otherwise competitive encounter with draw and QPR victory each at 28%. Last season's closing run clearly revealed Blackburn's marked inconsistency, mixing heavy defeats with attacking moments, while QPR's final campaign deteriorated notably, claiming only two points from their closing six matches. The overall head-to-head record favours QPR marginally. Both sides return to this level with Under 2.5 goals the model's lean at 54%, pointing toward a relatively controlled contest.
matches.preview_zh: Blackburn略佔上風，概率為45%，不過該模型表示這將是一場競爭激烈的比賽，平手與QPR勝利的概率各佔28%。上賽季尾段清楚顯示Blackburn明顯的不穩定性，既有慘敗也有進攻時刻，而QPR最後的賽季明顯惡化，最後六場比賽僅拿下2分。整體直接對戰紀錄略微傾向QPR。兩隊重返此級別，進球少於2.5球是該模型的傾向，佔54%，指向一場相對克制的比賽。

matches.preview: Bristol City holds the model's preference at 45%, though Portsmouth and the draw are equally weighted at 27% each, suggesting no decisive advantage. Last season's form data shows Bristol City with mixed results at home and away as they return to this level, while Portsmouth demonstrated superior consistency in their closing fixtures. The head-to-head record is predominantly Bristol City's, with dominant home wins of 5-0 and 3-0, though Portsmouth secured one 3-0 victory. The total-goals projection favours a low-scoring match, leaning to under 2.5 at 54%.
matches.preview_zh: Bristol City 在模型中的偏好度為 45%，而 Portsmouth 與平手均為 27%，表示沒有明顯的領先優勢。上賽季的戰績數據顯示 Bristol City 在主客場均表現不穩定，而他們重返此級別，Portsmouth 則在最後幾場賽事展現出更為穩定的表現。交戰紀錄以 Bristol City 為主，Bristol City 有過 5:0 與 3:0 的主場大勝，但 Portsmouth 也曾取得一場 3:0 的勝利。進球數預測傾向低比分比賽，預期不超過 2.5 球的可能性為 54%。

matches.preview: Norwich hold a narrow edge at 39%, though Burnley's 34% and draw at 28% suggest this is finely balanced. Norwich showed mixed form in recent competition, with wins at Bristol City and Millwall offset by defeats to Hull and Ipswich. Burnley's recent run was poor, with two draws in six games and four losses. Burnley hold sway in head-to-head play, having won four of the last five meetings, including 2-1 and 3-0 victories. The goal market edges toward an open contest at 52% for over 2.5, suggesting the model anticipates attacking contributions from both sides.
matches.preview_zh: Norwich以39%略佔上風，儘管Burnley的34%及和局的28%顯示這場比賽勢均力敵。Norwich在近期比賽中表現不穩定，在Bristol City和Millwall的勝利被Hull和Ipswich的敗績所抵銷。Burnley最近成績欠佳，六場比賽中兩場平局、四場敗績。Burnley在相互對戰中佔據優勢，在過去五次交手中贏得四場，包括2:1和3:0的勝利。進球預測傾向於開放的比賽，52%支持2.5球以上，暗示模型預期雙方都將有進攻貢獻。

matches.preview: Cardiff are returning to this level after a season outside the top two English divisions. The model favours Sheffield United slightly with a 39% win probability, though the contest remains finely balanced at this stage of the season. Sheffield United have won all five recent meetings between the sides, including a 2-0 victory on their last away visit. Their recent form shows three wins and three defeats across their latest outings. The model leans modestly towards over 2.5 goals at 54%.
matches.preview_zh: Cardiff經過一個不在英超英冠的賽季後，正回歸至此級別。模型略微看好Sheffield United，勝率為39%，不過在賽季此階段，比賽仍保持勢均力敵。Sheffield United在最近五次交手中全數獲勝，其中包括上次客場的2-0勝利。他們最近的戰績為三勝三敗。模型傾向於進球數超過2.5球，機率為54%。

matches.preview: The model marginally favours Charlton at 39% but this is a closely contested fixture with Preston given a 32% chance. In their last two encounters, Preston have won both, triumphing 2-1 away and 2-0 at home. Both sides showed inconsistent form at the end of last season; Charlton managed one win in six matches whilst Preston claimed two victories over the same period. The model expects a low-scoring game with under 2.5 goals at 57%, indicating a tightly competitive encounter.
matches.preview_zh: 模型微幅傾向 Charlton（39%），但本場與 Preston 的對戰仍屬勢均力敵，Preston 的勝算為 32%。在過去兩次交手中，Preston 全勝，客場以 2-1 勝出，主場 2-0 獲勝。雙方在上一賽季末表現不穩定；Charlton 六場中僅勝一場，而 Preston 在同期奪得兩場勝利。模型預期本場為低比分比賽，少於 2.5 球的機率達 57%，顯示這將是一場激烈競爭的較量。

matches.preview: Southampton are marginal favourites at 46 per cent according to the model, though with Millwall at 28 per cent and a 27 per cent draw probability, this contest appears finely balanced. Before the summer break, Southampton recorded four wins from six matches while Millwall took three victories in the same span. The sides drew in January, but Millwall had won their previous two encounters. The model leans slightly to over 2.5 goals at 52 per cent, suggesting an open match.

West Ham is favored to win at 57%, with Watford at 19% and a draw at 25%. Watford ended last season with five defeats in six matches and a single draw. West Ham's record from the same period showed two victories alongside three defeats. The head-to-head record strongly favours West Ham, who won three of the last five encounters and regularly scored multiple goals. The model leans toward goals, with over 2.5 at 57% a slight edge over under 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: West Ham獲預測勝率為57%，Watford為19%，平手為25%。Watford上賽季最後六場比賽中五敗一平。West Ham同期戰績為兩勝三敗。對陣戰績明顯偏向West Ham，近五次交手中West Ham贏下三場，並經常打入多球。分析模型傾向預測進球較多，超過2.5球的概率為57%，略高於不足2.5球。
